player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long wanpela gem bilong GameOfPureStrategy.
- Yu holim 13 kadi A-K; wanwan inap usim wanpela taim.
- Wanpela raun wanpela kadi pris i kamap. Pleya wanpela kadi tasol long raitim samting i gat wanpela token i go insait long braket olsem '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kadi i go antap winim pris (plus karim i go). Tais rol pris i go insait long pot bilong neksta raun.
- Wanpela i gat total i winim long 13 raun win.

board.hand: Han bilong yu i stap yet: {hand}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wok i mas kisim wanpela tok kadi long braket.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Yu no gat dispela kat moa.
